name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement quantum phase estimation in Qi
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement quantum phase estimation in Qiskit with 6 counting qubits to estimate the phase of the eigenvalue exp(2*pi*i*0.015625) of a phase gate. Print the estimated phase and the error. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
